brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/mne/forward-inverse
brainlife.readme:
to be edited

**Use for:** Building inverse operators and source estimates.

**Not for:** Other subjects or sensor layouts than the ones it was computed for. Telling forward from inverse without checking the fwd/inv tags.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 4 Apps, output of 3 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.forward-inverse.json

files.desc: MNE forward solution (lead field) for one subject's sensors and source space.

identifying_risks: The source space follows the subject's cortical surface from MRI.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level derivative of MRI anatomy and sensor geometry.
sharing_cautions: Share with the same controls as the subject's MRI derivatives.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the embedded measurement info keeps subject_info or dates.
